headline: Mexican Peso Appreciates Against the Dollar Amid Moderation of Bets on Fed Rate Hikes
summary: The peso gained in a volatile session driven by comments from several key Federal Reserve officials and shifts in bets on interest rates.
why: The Mexican peso is one of the most traded emerging-market currencies, and its moves track US interest-rate expectations. Fed policy shapes global dollar funding conditions.
why_moved: Moderating bets on Federal Reserve rate increases, after comments from several Fed officials, supported the peso.
original_headline: Peso mexicano se aprecia frente al dólar ante moderación de apuestas sobre alza de tasas de la Fed
